::: {#def-gan}

#### Generative adversarial network (GAN)

A **generative adversarial network**,
or **GAN**,
has a generator $G$,
which maps a draw $\vz$ of noise to a data point $G(\vz)$,
and a discriminator $D$,
which gives the probability $D(\vx)$ that a data point $\vx$ is real.
They are trained in turn,
$D$ to maximize and $G$ to minimize

$$
V(D, G) = \E{\logf{D(\vecf{X})}} + \E{\logf{1 - D(G(\vecf{Z}))}},
$$

where $\vecf{X}$ is a real data point and $\vecf{Z}$ is the noise
[@goodfellow2014generative, section 3].

:::
